rv.q: With some reservations, this musical production of The Great Gatsby can be recommended for those individuals who are looking for something different.
Sadly, the five-star production values are wrapped around a barely two-star adaptation of the novel itself.

And this show, which is running through May 31 at the Benedum Center in Downtown Pittsburgh as part of the Pittsburgh Cultural Trust's PNC Broadway in Pittsburgh Series, has glimmers of fun and heart.

While visually stunning and brimming with high-caliber talent, The Great Gatsby musical struggled to translate the novel's narrative into a compelling stage experience on Wednesday night at the Music Hall at Fair Park.
But in the end, it seems to be about nothing so much as Jay Gatsby’s (Jake David Smith) parties and what they wore—and that is simply not enough to merit two-and-a-half hours of stage time.

cn.t: A visually stunning production with Tony-winning costumes and lavish design, but critics find the musical adaptation falls short of Fitzgerald's novel, favoring style over substance with a forgettable score.
